card.statement:
In this paper we construct two free field realizations of the elliptic affine Lie algebra $\mathfrak{sl}(2,R)\oplus \Omega_R/dR$ where $R=\mathbb
C[t,t^{-1},u\,|\, u^2=t^3 - 2b t^2 + t]$. The first realization provides an analogue of Wakimoto's construction for Affine Kac-Moody algebras, but in the setting of the elliptic affine Lie algebra. The second realization gives new type of representations analogous to Imaginary Verma modules in the Affine setting.
card.label: Abstract

paper.title: Free Field Realizations of the Elliptic Affine Lie Algebra $\mathfrak{sl}(2, R) \oplus\left( \Omega_R/dR\right)$

The first realization gives an analogue of Wakimoto's construction for Affine Kac-Moody algebras, but in the setting of the elliptic affine Lie algebra. The second realization gives new type of representations analogous to Imaginary Verma modules in the Affine setting.
